name: Topview
summary: Topview: AI video ads from product links and scripts.
description: Topview turns URLs, scripts, and product assets into short video ads with avatars, captions, and templates for social placement.
features: AI avatars and auto captions for vertical formats.
Template library for e-commerce and app promos.
Batch export for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.
